theorem contMDiff_iff_continuous_and_comp_immersion
    {M N : Type*} {H : Type*} {H' : Type*}
    [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace H']
    [ChartedSpace H M] [ChartedSpace H' N]
    (f : M → N) (n : ℕ∞) :
    ContMDiff n f ↔ 
      Continuous f ∧ 
      (∀ {P : Type*} {H'' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H''] [ChartedSpace H'' P],
       ∀ (i : N → P),
         Manifold.IsImmersion i → ContMDiff n i →
         ContMDiff n (i ∘ f)) := sorry
